mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO coupon_issue_request (stock_id, user_id, coupon_name, coupon_type, price, status, created_date, updated_date) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{userId}, #{couponName}, #{couponType}, #{price}, #{status}, NOW(6), NOW(6))
mapper.sql: id, stock_id, user_id, coupon_name, coupon_type, price, status, coupon_id, reason, created_date, updated_date
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM coupon_issue_request WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND updated_date < DATE_SUB(NOW(6), INTERVAL #{olderThanMinutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY id

SELECT
FROM coupon_issue_request WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT stock_id FROM coupon_issue_request WHERE status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_issue_request SET status = 'ISSUED', coupon_id = #{couponId}, updated_date = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE coupon_issue_request SET status = 'REJECTED', reason = #{reason}, updated_date = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE coupon_issue_request SET status = 'SOLD_OUT', reason = #{reason}, updated_date = NOW(6) WHERE id IN #{requestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
